name: FeatureRow
description: Alternating media and copy row for mid-page feature sections.
designIntent: Landing pages alternate a product shot with a short feature story. FeatureRow owns the two-column rhythm and media side without taking over the page h1, which belongs to Hero or PageHeader.

props.name: media
props.description: Image, mockup, video or form shown beside the copy.

props.name: mediaPosition
props.description: Which side the media sits on at lg and up.

examples.title: Alternating feature
examples.code: } actions={} />
examples.description: A standard feature row with media on the right.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use FeatureRow for the page hero
antiPatterns.explanation: Use Hero for the opening story and h1. FeatureRow defaults to h2 and is intended for mid-page sections.

accessibility.implementation: Renders h2 by default and accepts level 3
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the outline sequential under the page h1

accessibility.implementation: Media is a slot; the consumer owns alt text
accessibility.userRequirements: Give informative media alt text and hide decorative media

compositionRules.relationship: Place FeatureRow inside a Section, usually three to five in sequence
